attchmntText: Astra Microwave Products Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release on the Un-Audited Financial Results of the Company for the Second quarterand Half Year ended 30th September, 2026".
voiceSummary: Astra Microwave Products Limited announced unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 261 crores, up 22.5% year-on-year. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 47 crores, a 126.5% increase. For the half year, standalone revenue was Rs. 437 crores, with profit after tax at Rs. 57 crores. The consolidated order book stood at Rs. 4,708 crores as of September 30, 2026. Standalone order book was Rs. 3,937 crores. Orders received during the quarter were Rs. 2,036 crores. Geographical revenue for the quarter showed India at 93.8% and exports at 6.2%.

attchmntText: Astra Microwave Products Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Astra Microwave Products Limited filed an investor presentation for Q2 and FY27 with BSE and NSE on November 12, 2026. The standalone revenue for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 261 crore, up 22.5% year-on-year. Standalone EBITDA was Rs. 87 crore, up 87.4%, with a margin of 33.2%. Standalone PAT was Rs. 47 crore, up 126.5%, with a margin of 18.0%. The consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 was Rs. 263 crore, up 22.6%. Consolidated EBITDA was Rs. 89 crore, up 86.0%, with a margin of 33.8%. Consolidated PAT was Rs. 52 crore, up 117.5%, with a margin of 19.8%. The order book as of September 30, 2026, stood at Rs. 2,156 crore.

attchmntText: Astra Microwave Products Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Astra Microwave Products Limited filed a statement under Regulation 32 of SEBI Listing Regulations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company confirms there is no deviation or variation in the use of proceeds from the preferential issue raised on June 30, 2025. The total issue size was INR 173.99 Crores. As of June 30, 2025, the company received INR 43.49 Crores, representing 25% of the issue size. This amount was fully utilized during the quarter ended September 30, 2025. No further proceeds were raised during the quarter ended September 30, 2026, as the warrant conversion option was not exercised. The monitoring agency is CRISIL Ratings Limited. The audit committee and auditors have not raised any comments regarding the utilization of funds.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Astra Microwave Products Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report concerns the utilization of proceeds from a Preferential Issue of convertible warrants totaling Rs 173.99 crore. The issue period was June 23, 2025, to June 24, 2025. The company received Rs 43.49 crore during the quarter ended June 30, 2025. Rs 130.50 crore remains unutilized and yet to be received from warrant holders. No proceeds were utilized during the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The funds are allocated to working capital requirements of Rs 130.50 crore and general corporate purposes of Rs 43.49 crore. There were no deviations from the objects, no changes in the means of finance, and no major deviations observed compared to earlier reports. Warrant holders have the option to convert warrants into equity shares by December 29, 2026.

attchmntText: Astra Microwave Products Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Astra Microwave Products Limited reported standalone un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 12, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 26,093.40 lakhs, and profit for the period was Rs. 4,690.51 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 4.94 basic and Rs. 4.89 diluted. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 43,713.94 lakhs, and profit for the period was Rs. 5,672.76 lakhs. Earnings per share were Rs. 5.97 basic and Rs. 5.92 diluted. The company also noted the approval of a scheme of arrangement for the demerger of its Space, Meteorology and Hydrology Business to Astra Space Technologies Private Limited on June 10, 2026. This scheme is pending requisite approvals.
